source: Cboe daily VX futures settlements (Settle = DCRP, monthly contracts only) + Cboe VIX index daily history
note: Columns are keyed by contract expiry (final settlement date). Frozen so the notebook lands on the published numbers without re-hitting Cboe; set REFETCH=True in the notebook to pull live and diff.

actions_seed0.parquet.note: daily action index (0..4 = the five actions of eq 3.1) behind the published network numbers: kfold_pwl/kfold_exp = the paper 10-fold design, decay_pwl = fitted once through 2020-11-06 and run forward. Shipped because a 5-way argmax over close values is hardware- and seed-dependent; every other number in the notebook is deterministic.
